# **ICSG Insight** #### **ICSG SECRETARIAT BRIEFING PAPER** **April 2009 - No. 6** ### ICSG Trends: Recent Indicators of Economic and Copper Sector Performance The sixth ICSG Insight in the series provides up ‐ to ‐ date quarterly economic and copper sector data for ICSG member countries including ICSG Member Country Refined Copper Production and Usage,
2007 vs 2008
real GDP growth, unemployment, interest **2007 vs 2008** and inflation rates, industrial production, stock market performance, trade balances 14,800 14,600 and exchange rates, as well as refined copper 14,400 production, usage and trade data. The latest 14,20014,000 ICSG figures indicate that refined copper 13,800 13,600 production in _ICSG member countries_ 13,400 increased 3.4% in 2008 from 2007 to reach 13,200 13,000 just over 14.7 million metric tons. Refined Refined Production copper usage in ICSG member countries 2007 increased 1.9% over the same period to an estimated 13.9 million metric tons. 14,800
